classification: Exact value changes preserved. All entries adapt long weapon description into weapon_visual and concise reader copy. Substantive lead revisions enlarge/rename Rook weapon to Faultbreaker and diversify Eris, Vey, Ketz and Silas power/progression. These are authorized frozen inputs, not output defects. Original authored draft files remain unchanged.

draft.name: Hushline

Bind a defeated great beast’s pursuit instinct into the harpoon, letting her hunt targets across broken terrain.

One hand wraps the shaft below the head; complete beak, counterweight and shaft end remain visible.
